ledger.claim: The trip's own telemetry establishes a route deviation under POL-RD-01. The governing trace distance is 10.78 km (EV-GPS-00106, weight 1.0, COMPLETE) against a booked optimal of 7.2 km (EV-TRIP-00106), an excess of 3.58 km equal to 49.72% of optimal. That clears both establishment limbs — far above the 0.8 km absolute threshold and far above the 20% relative threshold — so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. Per POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs: the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km of 10.8 km may not be cited for the threshold test.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07. It carries 169 fixes at an unbroken 10-second sampling interval with 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum inter-fix gap of 0 seconds, so none of limbs (a) to (c) is met — no 90-second gap, no 500 m jump, no sustained interval above 30 seconds. The deviation may therefore be established on the gps_trace alone and needs no independent corroboration of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. The trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-00106, and the trace and the fare breakdown begin at the recorded start of 2026-07-17T08:35:15+08:00, so limb (a) is satisfied; limb (b) is satisfied by the 3.58 km excess measured from an unimpaired trace. The rider's own profile adds no corroboration requirement: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 1, so the 4-or-more / 1-or-fewer trigger in POL-RD-08 is not met.

ledger.claim: No traffic advisory is on file, and I disclose the impairment: EV-ADVIS-00106-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, carrying the blocking issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, whose detail records that no LTA advisory covered Thomson Rd, the CTE or the Chin Swee tunnel in the 08:29-09:03 window. Under POL-RD-13 an asserted external traffic cause is tested against the advisory for this trip and nothing else; where the bundle holds none, POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. In any event the driver has filed no counterparty_statement at all, so no traffic excuse has been asserted from his side for the missing advisory to support or defeat.

The chat_log contains a single message and it is the rider's own, sent at 08:46:30: 'why we at havelock? bugis is behind us'. That is a complaint about the route, not an instruction. No waypoint_hint is present (the field is null) and no road is named, so the corroboration test in POL-RD-04 cannot be run against it and the clause is unavailable. Under POL-RD-14 a rider instruction the trace does not corroborate excludes no distance and leaves the excess as measured; here there was no instruction at all, and the message in fact confirms the rider never asked to be taken via Havelock.

The optimal route carries no ERP whatever: trip_record.optimal_route_erp_sgd is 0.00, and its source names Thomson Rd to Bukit Timah Rd to Rochor Canal Rd with no gantry. Both charged gantries — CTE (Braddell Rd towards City) at $3.00 and CTE (Chin Swee Rd tunnel, towards City) at $2.50 — carry on_optimal_route false, and the trace passes within 0 m and 24.1 m of them, so they are genuine crossings rather than phantom lines and POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity relief is not the route to recovery. The full $5.50 is nonetheless recovered to the rider because POL-RD-09(1) comprehends off-route ERP inside the POL-RD-02 recomputation, which rebuilds the fare on a route with no gantry; that $5.50 must never be added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, and fare_model is METERED so that clause governs. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 7.2 + 0.28 x 19.0) x 1.0 surge read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP on the optimal route + 0 fixed surcharge + 0 waiting-time fee - 0 promo = 15.32. Charged_total is 26.04. Refund = 26.04 - 15.32 = 10.72, above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor, and the payable amount rounds UP to SGD 10.75. The refund is 41.2% of charged_total, below the 90% that would promote it to FULL_REFUND, so the outcome the record supports is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 10.75.

This is a metered taxi trip, not an upfront-quoted or pooled one, so neither bar on the rider's remedy applies. fare_model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null on EV-FARE-00106, so POL-RD-11 — which would close the distance-and-time refund route — does not run; and vehicle_type is RYDE_TAXI on EV-TRIP-00106, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not displace the 7.2 km booked optimal. The ordinary POL-RD-02 recomputation therefore governs and the rider's distance-and-time overcharge is refundable.

The charge is currently fully in place: payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00 on EV-FARE-00106. NO_ACTION is party-relative under POL-GEN-03 and on this rider-filed dispute would leave the rider carrying the whole $26.04, including $5.50 of ERP for tunnels the optimal route never uses. That is not the outcome the evidence supports; the partial refund under POL-RD-02 is what returns the off-route money to the party who paid it.

I do not overstate the grade of this deviation. The excess of 3.58 km is 49.72% of optimal and so falls just short of the 50% that would make it MATERIAL under POL-RD-01, and the driver's own profile would not support a repeat-pattern finding in any event: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 96, below both POL-RD-06 thresholds, and prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter that POL-RD-06 does not use and POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting. ledger.claim: On the governing trace figure this trip's excess is 3.58 km, or 49.72% of the 7.2 km optimal route. Both materiality gates in POL-RD-01 therefore fail: the excess is not greater than 50% of optimal and not greater than 8.0 km absolute. The deviation is at most ESTABLISHED, never MATERIAL, and POL-RD-01's own direction that the 10.78 km trace distance govern — not the rounded trip_record copy, which may not be cited for this test — is what fixes that number.

The remedy is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, not the rider's narrative: charged_total 26.04; recomputed_fare = 3.80 base + (0.75 x 7.2 km = 5.40) + (0.28 x 19 min = 5.32), at surge 1.0 read from the fare_breakdown, plus 0.80 platform fee, plus zero on-optimal-route ERP = 15.32; refund = 26.04 - 15.32 = 10.72, rounded up to a payable of 10.75. The rider's claimed figure overstates the refund by 15.32, and POL-RD-02 requires those three lines to be stated separately rather than merged into the contested sum.

The 5.50 of ERP the rider presents as something extra she 'would never have paid' is already comprehended in the POL-RD-02 refund: the recomputed fare includes ERP for gantries on the optimal route only, and this route carries none (optimal_route_erp_sgd 0.00), so both charged gantries sit inside the 10.72 figure. POL-RD-09(1) expressly forbids adding off-route ERP on top of the POL-RD-02 amount; awarding the rider 26.04 would charge the driver twice for the same 5.50.

The refund on this record is 41.17% of the 26.04 charged, far below the 90% share POL-RD-02 requires before a FULL_REFUND may issue. The whole contested amount cannot be returned on any view of the policy arithmetic, and reaches_full_refund_share is false on the money block itself.

No repeat-deviation pattern is available against this driver: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 and driver_profile.completed_trips_90d is 96, so neither limb of the POL-RD-06 test is met — not 3 or more flags, and not a ratio of 0.05 or more with at least 40 completed trips. The rider-favourable tie-break, the FULL_REFUND uplift on distance and time, and the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral all fall away, and POL-GEN-01 permits only those two named fields to be used for this test.

Both ERP lines are real crossings of the corridor actually driven, not phantom charges: the trace passes 0.0 m from the CTE (Braddell Rd) gantry and 24.1 m from the CTE (Chin Swee tunnel) gantry, both well inside the 250 m match radius POL-RD-09 applies. Every charge line in the fare_breakdown has a counterpart in the trace, so no standalone billing-integrity refund under POL-RD-09(4) arises on top of the POL-RD-02 figure.

The bundle holds no traffic advisory for the trip window — EV-ADVIS-00106-01 is MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0 — and neither party asserts an external traffic cause: the driver asserts none and offers no traffic excuse. POL-RD-13 therefore settles the point, that no traffic assertion can reduce the measured 3.58 km excess and no amended optimal can be supplied from an absent advisory, and because no party cites the missing identifier as an excuse this remains a POL-RD-10(5) gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it, so the case resolves on the trace and on the POL-RD-02 arithmetic.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties actually agree on the arithmetic; the case turns on the deviation finding and on how the fare is rebuilt.

Deviation. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00106, weight 1.0, COMPLETE) records 10.78 km over 169 fixes at an unbroken 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum inter-fix gap of 0 seconds. POL-RD-07 is therefore not engaged: none of limbs (a) to (c) fires, so the deviation is established on the trace alone and needs no independent corroboration. POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure to govern, not the rounded trip_record copy: measured against the booked optimal of 7.2 km (EV-TRIP-00106), the excess is 3.58 km, or 49.72% of optimal. That clears both establishment limbs (over 0.8 km and over 20%) but falls just short of both materiality limbs (not over 50%, not over 8.0 km). The deviation is ESTABLISHED, not MATERIAL. No POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is required, and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d of 0 against completed_trips_90d of 96 would not support a repeat-pattern finding in any event, so no tie-break, no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral arise.

No exculpatory clause runs. The bundle holds no traffic advisory for the 08:29-09:03 window: EV-ADVIS-00106-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and neither party asserts an external traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and POL-RD-13 confirms that an uncited traffic excuse carries no weight. The single chat message (EV-CHAT-00106, weight 1.0) is the rider's own complaint at 08:46:30, 'why we at havelock? bugis is behind us', not an instruction, and its waypoint_hint is null, so POL-RD-04's corroboration test cannot be run and the clause is unavailable (POL-RD-14). There is no pickup or dropoff amendment (POL-RD-05), the fare is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null (POL-RD-11 does not run), and the vehicle is RYDE_TAXI, not RYDE_POOL (POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not displace the 7.2 km booked optimal).

Remedy. Under POL-RD-02 the refund is arithmetic. charged_total 26.04. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 7.2 km = 5.40 + 0.28 x 19.0 min = 5.32) x surge 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP on the optimal route = 15.32. Refund = 26.04 - 15.32 = 10.72, above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% share that would promote it to FULL_REFUND, rounded UP to a payable of SGD 10.75.

The $5.50 of ERP. Both gantries, CTE (Braddell Rd towards City) at $3.00 and CTE (Chin Swee Rd tunnel, towards City) at $2.50, are genuine crossings: the trace passes 0.0 m and 24.1 m from them, well inside the 250 m match radius, so there is no phantom line and no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity refund, and no referral follows. Because the optimal route carries no gantry (trip_record.optimal_route_erp_sgd 0.00), the whole $5.50 is already comprehended inside the POL-RD-02 recomputation. POL-RD-09(1) forbids adding it on top; awarding $26.04 or $16.25 would charge the driver twice for the same ERP. That is why NO_ACTION, which on this rider-filed dispute would leave the rider carrying all $26.04 including ERP for tunnels the optimal route never uses, is not the outcome the evidence supports.

Rider: the charge is corrected and SGD 10.75 is returned to you. Driver: the deviation is measured but not material, and no pattern, conduct or billing-integrity finding is made against you.

Confidence is 0.95. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact - EV-GPS-00106 (trace distance), EV-TRIP-00106 (booked optimal) and EV-FARE-00106 (charges and fare model) - stands at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0; the MISSING advisory at weight 0.0 carries no fact and does not drag the cap down. The monetary effect of SGD 10.75 exceeds the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so the ruling issues but is not executed automatically and is placed in the human queue for release. This ruling matches the earlier PARTIAL_REFUND precedents on POL-RD-01, POL-RD-02 and POL-RD-08; the 49.72% excess here keeps the deviation non-material and confines the remedy to the arithmetic partial refund.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
